name: Glass
description: A pane of glass over the scene behind the window. The backdrop is blurred and bends toward the edges like a bevelled lens, with slight colour fringing and a soft rim light. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the glass.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the glass is blurred (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the glass pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the glass pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the refracted backdrop

parameters.name: Refraction strength
parameters.description: How far the backdrop bends at the pane's bevelled edge

parameters.name: Bevel width
parameters.description: How far the lens bevel reaches in from the edge (px)

parameters.name: Colour fringing
parameters.description: Chromatic split between the red and blue refraction

parameters.name: Rim light
parameters.description: Strength of the rim light along the pane's edge

parameters.name: Tint strength
parameters.description: How much of the tint colour is mixed over the glass. The mix is gated by how far the backdrop's brightness sits from the tint's, so a tint close to what is behind the pane stays faint at every setting and the default white tint barely shows over a bright scene

parameters.name: Physically based refraction
parameters.description: Bend the backdrop with Snell's law instead of the simple offset. Ignored while Concave lens is on

parameters.name: Bevel intensity
parameters.description: How steeply the physically based bevel tilts the glass surface. Ignored while Concave lens is on

parameters.name: Corner lens
parameters.description: Extra outward lens pull toward the corners in the physically based mode. Ignored while Concave lens is on

parameters.name: Edge lighting
parameters.description: Add the backdrop's own light back along the bevel

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Saturation of the glass in the OKLab colour space, where 1.0 leaves it unchanged

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain that masks banding in the blurred glass

parameters.name: Tint colour
parameters.description: Colour mixed over the glass

parameters.name: Rim colour
parameters.description: Colour of the rim light

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the finished pane, the blurred scene with the pack's own rim light and glint already on it. 1.0 leaves it unchanged

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the finished pane around mid grey, rim light and glint included. 1.0 leaves it unchanged

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts

parameters.name: Bevel curve
parameters.description: Shape of the bevel falloff. 1.0 is the rounded bevel. Lower values carry the bend further inward and higher values keep it close to the rim

parameters.name: Concave lens
parameters.description: Shrink the whole backdrop toward the pane's centre near its edges, like looking through a thick concave slab, instead of bending only the bevel

parameters.name: Mirror at the edge
parameters.description: Where the bend reaches past the pane's edge, fold the backdrop back inside. Left off, the bend keeps reading the captured scene beside the pane, which can make the edges look see-through
